claims.quote: The Indawgyi stream catfish, Akysis prashadi, is an akysid catfish from Lake Indawgyi and the upper Ayeyarwady drainage in northern Myanmar.
It has also been recorded from the Lokchao river in Manipur, India.
Asia: Indawgyi Lake and northern Irrawaddy River basin, Myanmar.
